meta.note: Synthetic results are not performance claims. Headline numbers come only from test_real, and always PER STRATUM.
meta.selection_metric: validation only: mean(val_synthetic macro-F1, val_real balanced accuracy)

nn_similarity.note: For every val/test row we computed the maximum TF-IDF char-ngram cosine similarity to ANY train row (`results/nn_sim.parquet`). A high value means the row has a near-copy in training, so its score partly measures memorisation.

metric_guards.rule: recall@FPR=x only if n_negatives * x >= 5, else 'n/a (too few negatives)'

test_a.note: 10% of TRAIN clusters held out whole (both classes); measures seen-template wording, not new scams.

test_real.note: Synthetic results are not performance claims. Headline numbers come only from test_real, and always PER STRATUM.

real_english_combined.title: English real data, optimistic: sources differ in era and style, NOT a Hinglish claim
real_english_combined.source_origin_warning: AUROC close to source-origin AUROC means the score may reflect dataset recognition, not scam detection.
